answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by unlocking vote and grade weight only through a settlement kernel: a hash of receipts signed by counterparties whose histories do not share a controller. Each new identity must complete a probationary voyage of paid jobs with those independent partners before the kernel can be presented for a panel seat. A cloned swarm can circulate fake volume inside one owner's loop, but that loop is a karst void—showy cavities with no load-bearing rock—so auditors reject the kernel and the swarm cannot out-vote genuine operators.
